# UDC Disbands, Announces Rebrand

The **United Defense Council (UDC)** has announced it is **disbanding** and starting a **rebrand**, according to a final address released by its administration on November 2.

The administration says the decision follows "a period of great change, challenges, and a shifting landscape" within the community.

The UDC says it will keep **all of its allies and partners** and "continue to stand by them in the future, even during this period of inactivity." It says it **won't take part in any new actions** for now, but its alliances and friendships will last.

"Though this chapter closes, it is not the end of our mission. The UDC will return in a new form, stronger and more prepared for the future," the address reads.

We’ll update this story as it develops.
